title: Keep model affinity inside a coherent work loop
narrative: Within one coherent loop, Nubble wants routing to prefer the already-chosen lane unless a phase boundary justifies a switch. Random lane thrash must not win on unit price alone.
implementation:
`route_at_boundary` selects lanes at task/phase boundaries; `activate_scoped_policy` activates judgement policy only when calibration criteria are met — affinity and activation stay behind evaluation, not cheapest unit price.

Covers: RTE-03.
validation: Kind `model_affinity` → `_run_model_affinity`. Soft expects: preferred lane selected for task kind; uncalibrated policy activation returns null. Unit: `tests/test_routing.py`.
